job.title: Social Care Worker
job.description:
Discovery & Assessment of Needs Project - Social Care Worker

Location: North Dublin, with some travel to satellite locations
Duration: Approximately 8 weeks
Contract Type: Project-Based / Temporary
HSE Payscale

We are currently recruiting Social Care Workers to join a Multidisciplinary Team (MDT) for an exciting Discovery and Assessment of Needs Project within an adult Disability Team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for professionals who are passionate about person-centred practice, disability rights, social inclusion and supporting people to achieve meaningful life outcomes.

The project will focus on gaining a deeper understanding of the aspirations, goals and support needs of adults who use my client's services. The findings will help inform the future development and redesign of adult services in line with the principles of New Directions, ensuring that supports remain person-centred, evidence-based and focused on individual outcomes.

The Opportunity

Successful candidates will receive structured training and induction from the CRC in the assessment methodology before commencing the project. Ongoing support will also be provided throughout the assignment.

Over approximately 8 weeks, you will undertake scheduled assessments with adults attending services.

Assessments will explore:

  • Individual aspirations, goals and future plans
  • Community participation and social inclusion
  • Supports required to achieve meaningful outcomes
  • Unmet needs and opportunities for further development
  • Individuals' strengths, preferences and personal priorities

Requirements

  • Social Care degree
  • CORU reg
  • Irish working rights
  • Have experience working with adults with disabilities
  • Understand the principles of New Directions and rights-based service delivery
  • Have strong skills in engagement, interviewing, facilitation and information gathering
  • Can effectively engage with adults with diverse communication needs
  • Take a strengths-based and progressive approach to disability support
  • Are passionate about person-centred practice, social inclusion and empowering individuals to achieve their goals
  • Share values centred around respect, collaboration, quality and person-centred support

Interested?

If you are a qualified with relevant disability experience and would like to be considered for this project, we would love to hear from you.

Apply now to find out more about this exciting short-term project opportunity.

job.title: Automation Engineer
job.description:
Automation Engineer

Dunboyne, Co. Meath

A leading provider of OT, SCADA, telemetry, and communications solutions is seeking an Automation Engineer.

Join a team delivering cutting‑edge technologies and high‑quality SCADA solutions.

Overview

This role is primarily office‑based, with occasional site visits during deployment and commissioning phases. A major focus of the position involves working with Ignition, a web‑based HMI, SCADA, and MES platform, to deliver a high‑quality front‑end SCADA solution to clients.

The role requires ongoing communication with clients throughout implementation, as well as post‑deployment support for system queries or issues.

Key Responsibilities

  • Presales and design of new solutions and installations
  • Responding to customer and client requests as they arise
  • Liaising with Junior SCADA/Automation Engineers on PLC, HMI, and SCADA software implementation
  • Creating software design specifications and associated documentation
  • Using design tools such as InTouch, Ignition, Broadwin, and 1CC Flexible
  • Training clients on systems once implemented
  • Ensuring consistency of work across all projects
  • Working to project deadlines
  • Managing all files and licensing associated with projects
  • Interfacing with client IT departments regarding security
  • General housekeeping of all SCADA projects
  • Developing standards and specifications aligned with customer requirements
  • Creating standard libraries and productised solutions to improve efficiency in future project delivery
  • Producing work breakdown structures for your own projects and those of junior engineers

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong understanding of SCADA system architecture and components
  • Experience with SCADA platforms such as Ignition, Siemens WinCC, Wonderware, or similar
  • Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, etc.)
  • Knowledge of industrial communication protocols (Modbus, DNP3, OPC, etc.)
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience developing SCADA and PLC solutions
  • Demonstrated experience in software development and solution design with Schneider PLCs or similar
  • Experience using AI technologies
  • Knowledge of Microsoft SQL Database Manager
  • Familiarity with remote access tools (PC Anywhere, Remote Desktop, TeamViewer)
  • Understanding of data science and statistics
  • Ability to work with VB and SQL
  • Knowledge of Ethernet, TCP/IP, and related industrial networking protocols
  • Awareness of SCADA cybersecurity best practices
  • Experience designing and managing SCADA alarms

We are currently recruiting OTs to join a Multidisciplinary Team (MDT) for an exciting Discovery and Assessment of Needs Project within an adult Disability Team.

Assessments will explore:

  • Individual aspirations, goals and future plans
  • Community participation and social inclusion
  • Supports required to achieve meaningful outcomes
  • Unmet needs and opportunities for further development
  • Individuals' strengths, preferences and personal priorities

Requirements

  • Have experience working with adults with disabilities

job.title: Oncology Inpatient Nurse
job.description:
Key Responsibilities and Deliverable

  • Direct Patient Care:
    • Deliver direct care to assigned patients.
    • Conduct nursing history, summarize data, and identify nursing diagnoses and patient care needs.
    • Observe and record patient signs, symptoms, behaviors, and physiological status; communicate assessments and propose care revisions.
    • Implement individualized care plans for newly admitted patients as per policy.
    • Administer nursing interventions consistent with the medical care plan.
    • Handle admission, discharge, and transfer procedures; assist with patient activities and care.
    • Execute physician orders; safely administer medications and treatments.
    • Notify nursing and medical staff of any changes in patient status.
    • Independently assume responsibility for assigned patient care.
    • Perform specialty service techniques and routines.
    • Maintain aseptic techniques, isolation procedures, and infection control measures.
    • Document all nursing care in patient records.
    • Ensure patient privacy and confidentiality at all times.
    • Evaluate and reassess patient care, revising interventions and outcomes as necessary.
    • Assess patient understanding and compliance with healthcare instructions.
    • Review teaching documentation with the Nurse Manager or designee.
    • Adhere to department internal controls.

Clinical Responsibilities

  • Adhere to The Professional Scope of Practice Framework 2000 (Nursing & Midwife Board of Ireland).
  • Ensure individual patient assessments, care plans, and evaluations are in place.
  • Involve patients’ families and significant others as appropriate.
  • Provide care in optimal clinical environments, following all nursing and hospital policies.
  • Participate in and supervise patient meals and dietary needs.
  • Adhere to visiting time policies.
  • Delegate tasks appropriately based on skill level and knowledge.
  • Record documentation professionally, legibly, and promptly.

Managerial Responsibilities

  • Identify and communicate issues to the Nurse Manager promptly.
  • Demonstrate confidence and competence in hospital policies and guidelines.
  • Efficiently record necessary documentation.
  • Manage complaints effectively.
  • Monitor risk management processes.
  • Maintain effective interdisciplinary communication.
  • Deputize for the Nurse Manager as needed.
  • Engage in ward and hospital nursing communication.

Personal and Professional Responsibilities

  • Maintain a professional portfolio.
  • Utilize opportunities to educate patients and their families.
  • Attend relevant study days and courses.
  • Act as a preceptor or supervisor to students and new staff.
  • Participate in performance reviews with the Nurse Manager.

Educational Responsibilities

  • Enhance learning opportunities in the clinical area.
  • Participate in the clinical induction of new nursing and support staff.
  • Take responsibility for personal learning and development needs.

Qualifications

  • Registered General Nurse license in good standing with the Nursing & Midwife Board of Ireland (NMBI).

Experience

  • Preferably, 1 year of post-nursing registration experience.
  • Oncology experience is preferred.

Job-Specific Competencies and Knowledge

  • Teamwork: Ability to work as part of a multi-disciplinary team and demonstrate motivation and innovation.
  • Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Effective communication, presenting information clearly and concisely, and understanding change management.
  • Planning and Organising: Evidence of effective planning, organizing, and time management skills; flexibility in rotations, rostering, and attitude to work.
  • Knowledge: Recent and relevant experience in the specialized area and acute hospital setting; knowledge of new developments in specialized areas and national strategies in nursing care.

Senior Management – Change Enablement Project Office

Location: Dublin
Contract: Temporary

About the Role

Our client is currently going through a significant period of organisational change and is seeking an experienced Senior Management to establish and lead a Change Enablement Project Office (CEPO).

This is a senior role responsible for creating the governance, reporting, change management and programme oversight structures required to successfully deliver multiple major organisational change initiatives.

Working closely with senior leadership, internal teams and external partners, you will provide centralised coordination, governance and delivery assurance across a portfolio of strategic change programmes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Establish and operationalise the Change Enablement Project Office, including its governance framework, operating model, standards and processes.
  • Develop and maintain an integrated view of major organisational change initiatives, including milestones, risks, dependencies, benefits and organisational impacts.
  • Produce executive dashboards, reports and management information to support senior leadership decision-making.
  • Ensure alignment and consistency across multiple change and transformation workstreams.
  • Develop and implement change management, change readiness, stakeholder engagement and benefits realisation approaches.
  • Establish effective risk, dependency, escalation and assurance processes.
  • Monitor programme performance and organisational readiness, identifying issues and recommending corrective actions.
  • Build strong working relationships across HR, Finance, IT, Facilities, Communications, Strategy and other internal functions.
  • Support the development of sustainable organisational change capabilities.
  • Ensure change frameworks, processes and knowledge are successfully transitioned into business-as-usual operations.
  • Act as a trusted adviser to senior leadership on programme governance, portfolio management and organisational change.

Key Deliverables

The successful candidate will be responsible for establishing:

  • A comprehensive change management methodology.
  • A robust change governance framework.
  • Programme risk, dependency and escalation management processes.
  • Integrated executive reporting and portfolio dashboards.
  • Change readiness and benefits tracking mechanisms.
  • Effective governance and assurance arrangements across major change initiatives.

About You

We are looking for a highly experienced senior professional with a strong background in organisational change, transformation and programme management.

You will have:

  • A Level 8 qualification in a relevant discipline.
  • Minimum 7 years' experience leading complex change programmes or transformation initiatives.
  • Experience establishing and developing PMO, programme governance or transformation office capabilities.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills at all levels.
  • Experience producing integrated leadership reporting and developing change metrics and insights.
  • Strong experience in risk, dependency and benefits realisation management.
  • Excellent analytical, organisational and decision-making skills.
  • The ability to work confidently with senior leadership and multiple internal and external stakeholders.

Desirable

  • Level 9 qualification in Organisation Development or a related discipline.
  • Recognised change management qualification such as Prosci ADKAR or APMG Change Management.
  • Project management qualification such as PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner or Agile certification.
  • Experience within the public sector, regulatory or semi-state environment.

What We Are Looking For

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Senior Programme Manager, Transformation Lead, Change Director, Organisational Change Manager or PMO Lead who is confident operating at senior leadership level and has experience establishing governance and delivering complex organisational change.

If you have the experience and expertise to build and lead a change function through a significant period of transformation, we would be interested in hearing from you.

job.title: Case Worker
job.description:
Caseworker required to work in our Tullamore Office.

Primarily based in Tullamore 5 days per week but must be available to work in Birr as needed so must have full licence and full time access to a car.


Monday-Friday 09:00-05:00(on-site)
We are looking for candidates with strong customer service and administration experience.


ABOUT TURAS NUA
IPNES supports people who are over 12 months unemployed or employed part-time on low earnings, by providing intensive, targeted and personalised employment support services. The IPNES contract is delivered by Turas Nua, the Irish employability services provider. Turas Nua is wholly owned by FRS Network, an Irish cooperative social enterprise, which has been delivering services to Irish communities since 1980.


PURPOSE OF ROLE
As a caseworker, you will work with clients referred by the Department of Social Protection to IPNES. You will manage a caseload of clients, coordinating our internal support specialists and external organisations to provide a personalised, planned support service to each client, to help them gain sustainable employment. You will also provide each client with one-to-one advice and support to guide their progress towards employment.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop and manage a robust case management plan for each client, working towards sustainable, full-time employment.
  • use our industry-leading assessment technology to identify the client’s goals, ambitions, and barriers to employment. Use the output from the assessment to inform a structured personal progression plan, agreed with the client.
  • Recognise hidden motivations and conflict when assessing clients’ job-readiness, in order to address these with appropriate support and interventions.
  • Provide coaching and mentoring to clients, including providing intensive job search support when the client is job ready.
  • Identify, structure, and recommend training solutions in consultation with in-house tutors, to meet the specific learning and training needs of clients.
  • Fast-track job-ready clients for immediate job interviews brokered by our Employer Services consultants.
  • Maintain strong knowledge of the local labour market.
  • Organise a daily schedule that includes face-to-face meetings, phone calls, online meetings, and email correspondence with clients and other service providers.
  • Work closely with local and national specialist services (e.g., training, literacy, housing, health) to assist the client in their journey towards employment.
  • Present and facilitate workshops and group-learning presentations to clients weekly.
  • Achieve daily and monthly contractual key performance indicator (KPI) targets, managing a caseload of clients; for example, time-bound contacts, assessments, and support activities.
  • Provide guidance and support for more job-ready clients during their initial weeks of employment, helping them to successfully transition to sustainable employment.
  • Ensure that client interactions are recorded accurately on the CRM system.
  • Ensure data protection regulations are fully adhered to.


ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Leaving Certificate or equivalent.
  • Minimum of three years’ experience of working in a customer focused, target driven environment.
  • Strong IT skills/experience in the use of Microsoft office and CRM systems. Must be comfortable with all aspects of remote working technology.
  • Excellent administrative skills – fast & accurate data entry skills.
  • The ability to build rapport and work effectively with a diverse range of individuals both in person and over the phone.
  • Experience in delivering presentations in a group setting or public speaking.
  • Strong prioritisation and time management skills.
  • Fluent written and spoken English.

Recruiter:Joyce Coffey

job.description:
A reputable manufacturing organisation in County Limerick is seeking a Maintenance Technician to join their team.

The Company
My client operates within a manufacturing environment and is focused on maintaining high operational and service standards across its equipment and facilities. The maintenance team plays a key role in ensuring machinery reliability and minimising downtime through proactive and reactive maintenance practices.

The Role
This position involves working rotating shifts (early and late) and focuses on the maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of a range of machinery and systems.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Diagnosing faults and carrying out effective troubleshooting
  • Performing maintenance across mechanical, electrical and pneumatic systems
  • Monitoring and supporting PLC-controlled systems
  • Reading and interpreting technical manuals, schematics and circuit diagrams
  • Maintaining accurate records of repairs and servicing
  • Attending meetings and providing regular updates to management

Requirements:
To be successful in this role, you must demonstrate:

  • A minimum of 3 years’ experience within a maintenance or manufacturing environment
  • Strong mechanical knowledge (e.g. gearboxes, chains, bearings)
  • A solid understanding of electrical, mechanical and pneumatic systems
  • Ability to read electrical schematics, technical drawings and blueprints
  • Experience or exposure to PLC systems (desirable)
  • The ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team


Interested? Apply now for an immediate interview.

job.title: Senior Speech and Language Therapist - Hybrid 4 Day week
job.description:
Senior Speech and Language Therapist (Paediatric)

Location: Co. Wicklow (Hybrid)
Hours: 32 hours per week (flexible hybrid working)
Contract: Permanent
Reports to: Clinical Lead / Director
Salary: Negotiable - depending on experience

About the Service

We are working with a growing multidisciplinary children’s service providing high-quality, evidence-based assessment and intervention to children and young people.

The team works closely with families, schools and other healthcare professionals to ensure a holistic, child-centred approach to care.

The service has a strong emphasis on professional autonomy, collaboration and maintaining a healthy work-life balance while delivering high clinical standards.

The Role

We are seeking an enthusiastic and compassionate Speech and Language Therapist to join a supportive multidisciplinary team.

The successful candidate will assess and support children presenting with a range of communication needs and will work closely alongside Occupational Therapists, Psychologists and Assistant Psychologists.

This role offers flexibility, autonomy and the opportunity to contribute to the ongoing development of a growing private paediatric service.

Key Responsibilities

  • Carry out comprehensive Speech and Language assessments
  • Develop individualised therapy programmes
  • Deliver evidence-based intervention
  • Assess speech, language, communication and social communication needs
  • Work with children with developmental language disorder, speech sound disorders, autism, ADHD and other neurodevelopmental presentations
  • Complete feeding and swallowing assessments where appropriately trained
  • Provide AAC recommendations where appropriate
  • Produce high-quality assessment and therapy reports
  • Maintain accurate and timely clinical documentation
  • Liaise with parents, schools, preschools and other professionals
  • Participate in multidisciplinary assessments and team meetings
  • Contribute to integrated reports and case discussions
  • Support service development and quality improvement initiatives

Flexible Hybrid Working

This role offers a flexible hybrid working model to support both clinical delivery and work-life balance.

Working hours can be scheduled between 7am and 7pm Monday to Friday, subject to service needs.

Clinicians may select preferred working days in advance (minimum two weeks’ notice required to support scheduling).

Report writing, admin tasks, intake calls and preparation work can be completed remotely where appropriate.

A minimum of one on-site clinic day per week is required, with additional attendance for assessments, MDT clinics, parent meetings and service needs.

Essential Criteria

  • Qualification in Speech and Language Therapy
  • Experience working in Paediatric assessments ideally 3 years we would consider someone with 18+ months exp solely in paediatrics.
  • CORU registration
  • Experience working with a paediatric caseload
  • Strong communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and within a multidisciplinary team
  • Good organisation and time management skills
  • Full driving licence and access to transport

Desirable Experience

Experience in any of the following areas would be an advantage:

  • Autism
  • ADHD
  • Developmental Language Disorder
  • Speech Sound Disorders
  • Social Communication Difficulties
  • Early Intervention
  • School-aged populations
  • AAC
  • Parent coaching
  • School-based consultation

Benefits

  • Flexible hybrid working model
  • Monthly clinical supervision
  • CPD contribution
  • Private health insurance contribution
  • Fuel allowance for approved travel
  • Company mobile phone and laptop provided
  • Administrative support
  • Protected report writing time
  • 25 days annual leave (pro rata)
  • 7 days certified sick pay per year (policy dependent)
  • Maternity support scheme after qualifying service
  • Opportunity to contribute to service development within a growing team
  • Future leadership potential as the service expands

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Child-centred in their approach
  • Confident working independently
  • Collaborative within a team setting
  • Strong in clinical reasoning
  • Passionate about evidence-based practice
  • Committed to continuous learning and development
  • Comfortable working in a growing and evolving service

job.description:
Social Work Team Leader – Duty Child Protection

Location: North Dublin / Ballymun area
Contract: Permanent, Full-Time
Hours: 35 hours per week
Salary: €68,217 – €78,687 per annum
Service: Duty Child Protection (DCP)

FRS Recruitment is working with a leading statutory Child and Family Agency to recruit an experienced Social Work Team Leader to join their Duty Child Protection service in North Dublin.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Social Worker who is ready to take the next step in their career and take on a leadership position within a statutory child protection service.

The successful candidate will join an established Duty Child Protection team, providing professional leadership and support within a service focused on the safety, welfare and wellbeing of children and families.

About the Role

The Social Work Team Leader will play a key role in supporting the delivery of an effective, responsive and high-quality Duty Child Protection service.

Working within a child-centred and family-focused environment, you will provide professional leadership and guidance to Social Work staff, supporting effective decision-making and high standards of practice.

The role will suit an experienced Social Worker who has a strong understanding of child protection and safeguarding and is looking to develop their leadership career within a statutory setting.

You will have the opportunity to use your professional expertise while supporting colleagues in managing complex situations and contributing to positive outcomes for children and families.

Key Responsibilities

As Social Work Team Leader, your responsibilities will include:

  • Providing professional leadership, guidance and support to Social Work staff within the Duty Child Protection service.
  • Supporting Social Workers with professional decision-making and the management of complex child protection and welfare matters.
  • Promoting high standards of social work practice and ensuring a child-centred approach to service delivery.
  • Supporting effective assessment, risk management and case planning.
  • Providing advice and professional guidance to team members where required.
  • Supporting the effective management and allocation of work within the service.

job.description:
HR Compliance Advisor

Location: Co. Cavan

Permanent Full Time

Hybrid Working - 2 days remote

Salary: €45,000 plus 10% bonus, private company pension and increasing annual leave with service.

The purpose of this role is to ensure the organisation consistently meets its obligations under Irish employment legislation, regulatory standards, and internal HR policies. The HR Compliance Officer will manage and monitor compliance activities relating to work authorisation, right-to-work verification, working time regulations, people data governance, and other key HR compliance areas, supporting effective risk management and maintaining a state of ongoing audit readiness.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage all aspects of work permit and immigration compliance, including applications, renewals, tracking, and expiry monitoring.
  • Liaise with external stakeholders, including government bodies, legal advisors, and relocation providers.
  • Ensure robust right-to-work verification processes and maintain compliance with employment eligibility requirements.
  • Support internal and external audits relating to immigration and work authorisation.
  • Monitor compliance with the Organisation of Working Time Act 1997, including working hours, rest periods, breaks, night work, and Sunday working requirements.
  • Partner with Operations, Payroll, and HR to review attendance data and identify compliance risks.
  • Support corrective actions and maintain accurate records to demonstrate statutory compliance.
  • Support GDPR compliance across HR processes, including data retention, lawful processing, access controls, and data minimisation.
  • Act as a key HR contact for data protection audits, DSARs, and people data governance matters.
  • Promote best practices in the management and protection of employee data.
  • Maintain accurate, audit-ready HR records and documentation in line with legal and organisational requirements.
  • Support internal compliance reviews and external audits, including WRC, customer, and certification audits.
  • Identify compliance gaps and drive corrective actions to completion.
  • Support the review, implementation, and monitoring of HR policies, procedures, and SOPs.
  • Maintain documentation and evidence to demonstrate compliance across HR activities.
  • Ensure all compliance requirements are completed during onboarding, including contracts, right-to-work checks, and employment permits.
  • Monitor compliance throughout the employee lifecycle, including recruitment, transfers, role changes, and offboarding.
  • Partner with Recruitment, Payroll, and HR Operations to ensure consistent and compliant processes.
  • Conduct periodic audits of employee records and lifecycle activities.
  • Support continuous improvement of onboarding and employee lifecycle compliance processes.
  • Monitor and report on key HR compliance metrics, including work permits, working time compliance, and audit findings.
  • Identify emerging compliance risks and legislative changes, recommending actions to mitigate exposure.
  • Support the Head of People & Development in managing people-related risk and maintaining audit readiness.
  • Maintain compliance reporting and tracking mechanisms to monitor performance and risk.
  • Drive continuous improvement of HR compliance processes, systems, controls, and documentation.
  • Promote a culture of compliance through stakeholder engagement, communication, and best-practice governance.

Skills & Qualifications:

  • 3+ years’ experience in HR operations, HR compliance, or workforce compliance roles.

job.title: Senior Project Manager
job.description:
Senior Project Manager

Location: Dunboyne, Co. Meath (Hybrid Working Model)

Introduction

A leading provider of communications, SCADA and instrumentation solutions, working across industrial sectors including water, power, utilities, corporate business, broadcasting and public safety. With a proven track record spanning over four decades, the organisation delivers innovative infrastructure and technology solutions to a diverse client base.

Overview of Role

As Senior Project Manager, you will be responsible for the successful delivery of significant multi-site infrastructure programmes. Acting as the primary interface between the company, clients, engineering consultancies and the wider supply chain, you will ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within scope and to agreed commercial objectives.

This is not a purely administrative project management position. We are looking for a commercially astute and delivery-focused professional who can independently lead major projects, manage contractual relationships, identify and secure project variations, control budgets and represent the company confidently at senior stakeholder level.

While experience in SCADA, automation or Operational Technology (OT) is advantageous, we are equally interested in candidates with strong commercial project management experience gained within infrastructure, engineering, utilities or similarly complex technical environments.

The Candidate

You are a commercially aware and delivery-driven project professional who takes ownership and leads from the front. You proactively manage programmes, identify risks and commercial opportunities, challenge assumptions and ensure accountability across project teams.

You are equally comfortable engaging with senior client stakeholders and engineering teams and can confidently lead complex project discussions while maintaining a strong focus on delivery, commercial performance and customer satisfaction.

Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Delivery

  • Take full day-to-day ownership of a major multi-site infrastructure project from mobilisation through to commissioning, handover and contractual closeout.
  • Develop, own and maintain the detailed project delivery programme, including design, procurement, engineering, FAT, site deployment, SAT and commissioning activities.
  • Maintain a clear understanding of the critical path and proactively manage project dependencies, constraints, interfaces and recovery actions.
  • Lead project mobilisation, kick-off meetings, internal delivery reviews, client progress meetings and programme reviews.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering resources, subcontractors, suppliers and external partners to achieve agreed milestones.
  • Ensure project deliverables are clearly defined, allocated, tracked and driven to completion.
  • Provide concise, accurate and timely project reporting to the Head of Delivery & Service and senior management.

Commercial & Financial Management

  • Take a commercially proactive approach to project delivery and actively protect the company's contractual and financial position.
  • Understand the project scope, pricing assumptions, commercial structure, contract requirements and agreed exclusions in detail.
  • Manage project budgets, cost forecasts, revenue, cashflow and cost-to-complete in conjunction with Finance and Commercial teams.
  • Prepare and support monthly applications for payment, ensuring completed work and earned value are accurately reflected in project valuations.
  • Identify scope change, additional works and potential variations at the earliest possible opportunity and ensure they are formally recorded.
  • Ensure variations are commercially assessed, priced and agreed before additional work is undertaken wherever practicable.
  • Monitor project margin and forecast financial performance throughout the project lifecycle, implementing corrective action where required.
  • Challenge scope creep and ensure the company is appropriately compensated for work outside the agreed contractual scope.
  • Maintain robust commercial records, project correspondence and supporting documentation for all claims, changes and decisions.

Customer & Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary day-to-day project contact for the client and associated engineering consultancy organisations.
  • Develop strong working relationships with client project teams, engineering consultants, operational stakeholders and third-party suppliers.
  • Lead structured client progress meetings and provide clear updates on programme, risk, commercial matters, actions and project delivery.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations through proactive communication, formal reporting and timely escalation of issues.
  • Represent the company professionally and confidently in senior project, technical and commercial discussions.
  • Work collaboratively with major engineering consultancy groups while ensuring the company's delivery and commercial interests remain appropriately represented.

Engineering & Technical Coordination

  • Work closely with Principal Engineers and technical specialists to coordinate design and engineering activities.
  • Ensure technical deliverables, Functional Design Specifications, drawings and engineering documentation are developed in line with the approved programme.
  • Coordinate technical reviews, FAT, SAT and commissioning activities and ensure actions are driven to timely closure.
  • Ensure engineering resources have clearly defined priorities, deliverables and deadlines.
  • Facilitate resolution of technical issues and ensure the appropriate engineering expertise is engaged where required.
  • Maintain sufficient technical understanding to lead complex systems integration projects; detailed hands-on SCADA programming experience is not essential.

Essential Experience

Technical & Professional

  • Minimum 5 years' project management experience within infrastructure, engineering, utilities, systems integration or a similarly complex technical environment.
  • Demonstrable experience delivering projects or programmes with values typically in excess of €1 million.
  • Proven experience managing complex, multi-site or phased delivery programmes from mobilisation through to handover.
  • Experience working directly with major clients and large-scale engineering consultancy organisations.
  • Strong programme planning, sequencing and critical path management capability.
  • Experience managing multidisciplinary engineering or technical delivery teams.
  • Proven track record of delivering technical projects safely, on programme and within agreed commercial targets.
  • Strong working knowledge of MS Project or equivalent project planning and project control tools.
  • Recognised Project Management qualification such as PMP, PRINCE2 or APM is advantageous but not essential where significant delivery experience can be demonstrated.

Desirable Experience

  • SCADA, industrial automation or Operational Technology projects.
  • PLC and control systems, telemetry or communications network projects.
  • Water or wastewater infrastructure and regulated utility environments.
  • Complex systems integration or cyber security projects within operational environments.
  • Experience working alongside major engineering consultancies.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management, Construction Management, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Willingness to travel throughout Ireland and attend client or project sites as required.
  • Full valid driving licence.
  • Flexibility to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team across office, site and remote environments.

About FRS Co-Op

FRS Co-Op was founded in 1980 by farmers to support their communities, and as Ireland has grown, so have we. Today we’re a multi-sector co-op with a focus on innovation, made up of fair minded experts who live and work in the communities that we serve. The FRS Co-Op has been finding ways to make Ireland work better for everyone for almost fifty years. While we still have farming in our DNA, it’s only part of what we do.

FRS Fencing is a division of FRS Co-Op, a trusted provider of premium fencing solutions across Ireland. We serve a wide network of resellers and retailers, combining decades of industry expertise with a commitment to quality, innovation, and customer partnership. Our mission is to support the growth and success of our customers through best-in-class fencing products and installation services.

Purpose of Role

The FRS Fencing - Contract Fencing Manager is responsible for driving sales of premium fencing products and installation services to members and customers of our cooperative. This role will focus on expanding market share, building strong relationships with key accounts, and identifying new business opportunities to support the continued growth of FRS Fencing.

Main Responsibilities & Activities

  • Manage and grow relationships with existing customers, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and repeat business.
  • Develop and execute a strategic sales plan to achieve ambitious growth targets.
  • Conduct regular market analysis to identify trends, competitor activity, and new opportunities.
  • Represent FRS Fencing at industry events, trade shows, and customer meetings.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (central purchasing, marketing) to ensure seamless order fulfilment and customer support.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations, proposals, and quotations.
  • Negotiate pricing, terms, and contracts in line with company guidelines.
  • Gather customer feedback and market intelligence to inform product development and service improvements.
  • Maintain accurate records of sales activity, pipeline, and customer interactions using sales tracking tools.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • New business acquisition and onboarding of fencing accounts.
  • Growth in sales revenue, margin and market share within our contract fencing business.
  • Achievement of monthly and annual sales targets.
  • Customer retention and satisfaction scores.
  • Quality and accuracy of sales invoicing (CRM/ERP), tracking and reporting.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: Proven track record in sales, preferably in agriculture, building materials, construction, or related sectors.

  • Full clean driving license and willingness to travel extensively.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to present and negotiate at all levels.
  • Relationship Building: Strong ability to develop and maintain long-term partnerships with customers.
  • Commercial Acumen: Results-driven with a strong understanding of sales processes and market dynamics.
  • Problem-Solving: Resourceful and proactive in addressing challenges and seizing opportunities.
  • Product Knowledge: Willingness to learn and promote the technical features and benefits of FRS Fencing products.
  • Collaboration: Team player who works effectively with colleagues across departments.
  • Tech-Savvy: Proficient in CRM & billing systems, Microsoft Office, and digital communication tools.
  • Customer-Centric Mindset: Passionate about delivering outstanding service and value to customers.#

job.title: Credit Controller & Accounts Coordinator - Mullingar
job.description:
Credit Control & Accounts Coordinator

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly organised, motivated and detail-focused Credit Control & Accounts Coordinator to join our team.

The role will involve managing customer accounts, supporting the timely collection of outstanding payments and assisting with a range of finance, administration and sales support activities. The successful candidate will be confident communicating with customers, comfortable working with financial information and able to manage several priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy.

Experience with Microsoft Business Central would be an advantage, although training can be provided for the right candidate.

Key Responsibilities

Credit Control

  • Take responsibility for monitoring customer accounts and outstanding balances.
  • Carry out regular follow-up of overdue invoices by telephone and email.
  • Maintain professional and positive relationships with customers while ensuring payments are collected within agreed terms.
  • Record customer discussions, payment arrangements and relevant account information accurately.
  • Review aged debt reports and highlight potential issues or risks to management.
  • Work proactively to reduce outstanding debt and support effective cash-flow management.
  • Follow agreed credit control procedures and escalate significant concerns when appropriate.

Customer Account Management

  • Maintain regular contact with customers to ensure accounts remain well managed.
  • Deal with customer account queries efficiently and work with internal departments to resolve issues.
  • Investigate discrepancies and assist with invoice and payment queries.
  • Ensure customer account information is complete, accurate and kept up to date.
  • Maintain clear and organised records of correspondence and account activity.

Sales & Product Administration

  • Process and maintain documentation relating to product sales and customer orders.
  • Coordinate relevant customer paperwork and supporting documentation.
  • Ensure required forms and information are completed accurately and within agreed timescales.
  • Provide administrative support to the sales team throughout the customer journey.
  • Assist with the preparation and organisation of documentation relating to funding, grants or other relevant schemes where required.
  • Liaise with customers and internal teams to ensure sales administration is completed efficiently.

Finance & General Administration

  • Assist with day-to-day banking and payment allocation duties.
  • Process and reconcile customer payments where required.
  • Apply VAT requirements accurately and maintain appropriate financial records.
  • Provide general support to the finance function as required.
  • Maintain efficient filing and record-keeping systems.
  • Assist with other administrative duties to support the smooth running of the business.

Skills & Experience

  • Previous experience in credit control, accounts, finance administration or a similar position.
  • Strong attention to detail and excellent organisational skills.
  • Comfortable communicating with customers by telephone and email.
  • Good understanding of credit control, invoicing, VAT and general financial procedures.
  • Ability to prioritise workloads, manage competing deadlines and work independently.
  • Good numerical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Professional, confident and approachable manner.
  • High level of accuracy when handling financial and customer information.

Desirable Experience

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Business Central or a similar accounting/ERP system.
  • Experience within a product sales, service, equipment or commercial environment.
  • Previous involvement with grant, funding or customer documentation processes.
  • Experience working alongside sales and finance teams.

Personal Attributes

  • Well organised, dependable and self-motivated.
  • Professional and confident when dealing with customers.
  • Persistent yet tactful when following up outstanding payments.
  • Trustworthy and discreet when handling confidential financial information.
  • Able to work independently while contributing positively to a wider team.
  • Practical, proactive and solution-focused with a positive can-do attitude.
  • Reliable and willing to take ownership of tasks from start to completion. #INDFRS1

job.title: Process Scientist /Wastewater Treatment Operator
job.description:
Currently seeking a Process Scientist /Wastewater Treatment Operator to join a chemical production company in Co. Cork.

This is a hands-on operational role involving wastewater process monitoring, laboratory analysis, chemical dosing support and production activities. The successful candidate will work across both production operations and laboratory environments, with a key focus on maintaining and optimising wastewater treatment processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Carry out routine sampling and laboratory analysis of water and wastewater samples.
  • Perform and interpret jar testing to support wastewater treatment optimisation, including coagulation and flocculation assessments.
  • Monitor wastewater treatment performance and assist with process adjustments to achieve compliance and operational targets.
  • Support chemical dosing operations and ensure correct chemical usage.
  • Identify and troubleshoot process issues, implementing corrective actions where required.
  • Maintain accurate operational, environmental and laboratory records.
  • Support chemical manufacturing activities and production processes.
  • Assist with plant maintenance, equipment checks and general housekeeping.
  • Operate production equipment, including forklift and bobcat (training can be provided where required).
  • Ensure compliance with health, safety and environmental procedures at all times.

Essential Requirements

  • Experience operating, monitoring or managing wastewater treatment systems, effluent treatment plants or water treatment processes.
  • Practical understanding of wastewater treatment principles, including sampling, jar testing, coagulation/flocculation and chemical dosing processes.
  • Experience with sampling, testing and monitoring water quality parameters.
  • Ability to interpret results and make practical process adjustments.
  • A practical approach with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a small operational team.
  • Good communication skills and attention to detail.

Applicants must be eligible to work in Ireland. The company are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role.

job.title: Design Lead/Coordinator
job.description:
FRS Recruitment are currently recruiting for a Design Lead / Coordinator on behalf of a well-established specialist contractor delivering controlled environments and high-specification internal fit-out projects across Ireland and Europe.

Based in Cork City, this opportunity would suit an experienced Design Coordinator looking to progress, or a Design Lead seeking to join an established in-house design team. The role offers hybrid working and exposure to a strong pipeline of specialist projects across Ireland and Europe.

Reporting directly to the Design Manager, the successful candidate will coordinate the design process across allocated projects from pre-construction through to completion. You will work alongside a strong design team, while collaborating closely with project teams, commercial teams, consultants and specialist subcontractors.

Experience within controlled environments would be highly relevant, although candidates coming from internal fit-out, office refurbishment, new-build offices, large-scale residential, healthcare or education projects would also have a very transferable background.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate design activities across allocated specialist construction projects.
  • Manage design deliverables from pre-construction through to completion.
  • Coordinate drylining, ceilings, partitions and internal finish packages.
  • Liaise with architects, consultants and specialist subcontractors.
  • Work closely with project, commercial and site teams.
  • Review drawings, specifications and detailed design information.
  • Manage technical queries, design meetings and drawing revisions.
  • Support value engineering and ongoing design improvements.

Requirements

  • Design Coordinator, Design Lead or similar construction experience.
  • Construction, engineering or architectural design third level education
  • Internal fit-out or refurbishment experience would be highly relevant.
  • Commercial, residential, healthcare or education experience considered.
  • Knowledge of drylining, ceilings, flooring and partition systems.
  • AutoCAD or similar design software experience is desirable.
  • Irish or UK construction experience highly advantageous.

Salary & Benefits

  • €50,000 - €60,000+ d.o.e.
  • Hybrid working available from the Cork City base.
  • Pension contribution
  • Life insurance and income protection provided.
  • Excellent opportunity for long-term career progression.

job.title: Director -Biopharma Laboratory Operations
job.description:
Director -Biopharma Laboratory Operations

A leading biologics company is seeking an experienced Director of Biopharma Laboratory Operations to provide strategic and operational leadership across a large scale GMP biopharmaceutical laboratory organisation,driving excellence in quality, compliance, innovation, and operational performance.

The Role

As Director of Laboratory Operations, you will:

  • Lead and optimise Biopharma GMP laboratory operations, ensuring quality, compliance, and operational excellence.
  • Develop laboratory strategy, performance standards, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Lead, coach, and develop laboratory leadership teams.
  • Oversee resource planning, budgets, equipment investment, and operational performance.
  • Partner with pharmaceutical stakeholders and senior leadership to support growth and innovation.
  • Ensure alignment with GMP, FDA regulations, and global quality standards.

About You

You are an experienced senior laboratory leader with a strong background in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CRO environments.

You will bring:

  • 10+ years’ experience in GMP laboratory operations or pharmaceutical development.
  • Proven leadership experience managing large laboratory teams and complex operations (5+years).
  • Strong knowledge of GMP regulations, analytical development, QC processes, method validation, release testing, and stability programmes.
  • Experience managing budgets, strategic planning, and operational improvement initiatives.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and team development skills.
  • Experience working across global teams, supporting business growth, or leading transformation initiatives would be advantageous.

What’s On Offer

  • A competitive executive level salary package, including performance related bonuses and comprehensive benefits.
  • A senior leadership role with significant strategic influence.
  • The opportunity to lead talented scientific teams and shape laboratory operations.
  • Career growth within an innovative life sciences organisation.

How to Apply

To be considered for this opportunity, please submit a CV that clearly demonstrates your laboratory leadership and management experience within a regulated pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CRO environment.

Your CV should clearly highlight:

  • The size, structure, and scope of the laboratory teams you have led.
  • Your leadership responsibilities across GMP laboratory operations, including quality, compliance, and operational performance.
  • Significant achievements such as operational improvements, process optimisation, laboratory transformation, continuous improvement initiatives, business growth, or productivity gains.
  • Experience managing budgets, laboratory resources, capital equipment, and workforce planning.
  • Examples of leading cross-functional teams and collaborating with senior stakeholders.
  • Experience delivering results within GMP-regulated environments, including oversight of analytical development, QC testing, method validation, release testing, and stability programmes where applicable.

Where possible, include measurable outcomes (for example, cost savings, efficiency improvements, reduced turnaround times, successful inspections, team growth, or other quantifiable business impacts).

Applications that clearly demonstrate strategic leadership, people management, and a track record of delivering operational excellence will be viewed most favourably.
